items.headline: Rodney Nelson has 142 rushing yards and 2 TDs, Miami (Ohio) beats Akron 34-14
items.description: — Rodney Nelson had a career-high 142 yards rushing and two touchdowns on 13 carries, Blayne Myrick returned an interception 34 yards for a TD, Miami (Ohio) beat Akron 34-14 on Saturday.
